queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS cnt
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
shares AS (
  SELECT order_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_invoice_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_diff
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_number) FROM Invoices;
